items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: No Miss Rose or Daisy I think the name is.

ctx.x: No Lee Collins used to talk to me about him. He'd leave once. Lee Collins had me to go down. I met his widow. You met his widow? I saw a picture of him. She was living up on Perdido Street. All that's torn down. I don't know where she is now.
No Miss Rose or Daisy I think the name is.
